title: Outdoor Grilled Ukrainian Vegetable Skewers
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Ukrainian dish featuring kaffir lime leaf and grilled to perfection, this meal is perfect for outdoor gatherings and can be prepared ahead of time.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add sliced zucchini, bell peppers, and onions to the bowl and toss to coat with the olive oil mixture.
Thread the vegetables, mushrooms, and kaffir lime leaves onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with crumbly feta cheese.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional kaffir lime leaves if desired.
